findings.product_scope: VeriPass is a KYC onboarding, verified identity storage, and auth/eligibility guardrail for downstream BICEC mobile apps. DGI, Sopra Amplitude, and core banking integration are out of scope now and are not a planned future path. Downstream access uses OS-aware app links (universal links, app schemes) with App Store / Google Play fallbacks.
findings.existing_documentation: Prior to this rescan, docs/ contained ~50 files scattered across maintainer docs, historical diagrams, ADRs, evidence, troubleshooting, and BMAD planning artifacts. The new master document BICEC-VERIPASS-VUE-ENSEMBLE.md consolidates everything in one place with C4 layered architecture and ~22 mermaid diagrams.
